notes:
I couldn't write any of the notes. The research stopped before I could read a single source page.

I tried to fetch four pages in one batch: the Enduring Word chapter on Proverbs 25, the Bible Hub commentary pages for verses 2 and 22, and the Precept Austin page on Proverbs 25. A coding mistake on my part meant the text of those pages never got pulled out. When I tried to check what had come back, the tool told me I had no more web calls left for this turn. My other tools have no internet access, so I couldn't search or fetch anything else.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point, and to leave gaps rather than fill them from memory. So I haven't written any verse notes, because none would have a source behind it.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll fetch and read the pages properly. I'd start with:
- **Traditional verse-by-verse reading:** Enduring Word on Proverbs 25, the Bible Hub and StudyLight commentary pages (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary) and Precept Austin.
- **Where traditions differ:** sources on the "burning coals" in v. 21–22 (which Paul also quotes in Romans 12:20) and on the glory of God and kings in v. 2, from teachers in each tradition.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes (useful for v. 7–8, 20, 23 and 27, where translations differ), plus Catholic and Orthodox sources where they discuss these verses.
